result.reason: The operative addition satisfies the preferred position, including the 90-day Services warranty, 12-month documentation-conformance warranty, all three specified remedies, applicable-law compliance, and malicious-code protection. It therefore also exceeds the fallback durations. The preexisting Y2K warranty and disclaimer remain operative, with the disclaimer already excepting express warranties. The drafting is substantively complete, although “professional manner and in a workmanlike manner” is slightly redundant and the remedy provision does not specify who elects among repair, replacement, and refund.
